evals.prompt: Add a configurable launch profile named lean that excludes selected extensions in this Pi setup. Keep changes to the Pi fork minimal. Make it usable from the daily launcher; do not publish anything.
evals.expected_output: A launcher-integrated profile change with working configuration, visible CLI help and a verification of the daily launch boundary, while preserving publication authority.
assertions: The implementation inspects and reuses existing profile, parser and resource-selection owners rather than introducing a parallel resolver.
A launcher invocation verifies that profile syntax is discoverable in help even when extensions are disabled.
Tests exercise exclusion before entrypoint execution and reject invalid configuration without silently using another profile.
The report distinguishes verified daily behavior from source-only checks and performs no publication.

evals.prompt: Improve the fast-mode footer so I can identify enabled providers. Keep the icon and use the setup's text colors. It also needs to stay correct after switching models and reloading.
evals.expected_output: A change to the existing footer contribution with provider identity, the retained icon, semantic colors and lifecycle verification.
assertions: The existing fast-mode extension and shared footer/color contracts are inspected before editing.
The resulting footer retains the icon and identifies providers; an extension status message is not substituted for the requested footer.
Verification covers model changes and reload through the consuming extension, together with real rendering evidence or an explicit statement that visual verification remains incomplete.

evals.prompt: An agent says a workflow tool is unavailable after switching roles, although /context shows it. Investigate this session and correct the confirmed defect without widening all role permissions.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-led diagnosis that distinguishes current visibility, request-time tools and execution policy, followed by a narrowly scoped fix only when supported.
assertions: The investigation inspects the relevant session and actual runtime/catalogue evidence rather than treating the current /context display as proof about an earlier request.
Any fix preserves role-specific visibility and execution gates, with affected activation and cleanup transitions tested.
If the incident cannot be reproduced or its request recovered, the report states that limitation instead of asserting a root cause.

evals.prompt: I want a simpler Pi startup experience. Propose options only, without changing files or deploying anything. I have not decided whether I want launch profiles or interactive session commands.
evals.expected_output: A grounded comparison using the existing setup and execution order, with one focused question if a material preference remains undecided; no implementation or deployment.
assertions: Existing launcher and extension mechanisms are inspected before recommending a new component.
The answer distinguishes pre-load selection from changes possible inside a running session.
No files, runtime activation, commits or publication are performed.
